title: init-scaffolded gate hooks exit 127 on venv-only installs — no warning at init or doctor
detail: Adopter walkthrough 2026-07-27: pip install prusik into a venv, prusik init scaffolds .claude/settings.json hooks calling bare 'prusik'. Claude Code resolves hooks against the launching shell PATH, not the init-time PATH — venv not activated => every hook exits 127. Neither init nor doctor surfaces this; the harness reads as wired but errors on every tool call.
repro: python3 -m venv v && ./v/bin/pip install prusik && cd repo && ../v/bin/prusik init && env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin sh -c 'prusik gate pre-tool'  # 127
